title: niphobolus subfurfuraceus
intro: Niphobolus subfurfuraceus, commonly known as Chinese Club Moss or Furuo, is a plant species belonging to the family Lycopodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus subfurfuraceus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential applications in the treatment of various diseases.
